label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Hey family,

I know some of y'all have been asking Mama if I'm coming to Thanksgiving this year, so I'll just answer it here: yes, I'm coming. Thursday, Nov 26, at Aunt Denise's in Macon, eating around 3. I've got the mac and cheese and two sweet potato pies, so make room.

I also want to say something about last year, because I know it's been sitting there and nobody's really talked about it. For those who weren't there, a conversation about my job got heated at the table, and I said some things I shouldn't have. I got smart and disrespectful, and that part was on me. Grandma ended up going out to sit on the porch for about an hour, and I still feel bad about that. That was her holiday and she deserved better from me.

To be clear, I'm not sorry for the work I do. I'm proud of it and that's not changing. But I am sorry for how I talked, and where I said it. Nobody at that table is a bad person, and I know there's love there even when we don't see eye to eye.

So I'm asking everybody for a truce, just for one day. Let's leave work and politics at the door. Also, I can't talk about any open cases anyway because of confidentiality, so if you're wondering about "the lawsuit," I really can't tell you anything. Not dodging, it's just the rules.

What I'd love to talk about instead: food, football, the babies, and Tasha's new boyfriend (sorry Tasha, you knew this was coming 😂).

I want this to be a good day. I miss being around all of y'all without that hanging over it. See you on the 26th, and Grandma, save me a seat next to you. ❤️

reasons: It omits that the relative likes to provoke and his affectionate August birthday thumbs-up.
